routing_rules: Semantic event + creature profile select the gesture; React is not a universal animation that means the same thing on every creature.
For new combinations, inherit personality from the head; use a compatible wing, claw or tentacle gesture only when that anatomy exists.
If an anatomy-specific gesture is missing, use a mild head look from an authored compatible fallback; do not stretch absent limbs. No fallback clip is implemented by this package.
Apply the per-event cooldown and suppress duplicate triggers during the active reaction.
Ordinary petting maps to Pet. The cat boundary reaction is occasional, then returns to neutral; no lasting relationship penalty.
Disliked treats must be declined before inventory consumption. Treat means accepted food, not a negative reaction.
A harmless surprise uses React; combat threat detection still uses combat logic.
Valence ranges from -1 (negative) to +1 (positive); arousal from 0 (calm) to 1 (excited). Numbers are tuning proposals, not measured behavior.
gameplay_integration: Not implemented; configuration is supplied for future event binding.
